02 / Behind the handle

Curiosity.
Code.
Community.

I’m brick — a Minecraft network owner and content creator who likes understanding the systems underneath the thing people actually see.

Brickworks is my own network: development, hosting and content. I enjoy both sides of it — the code behind the server and the people who make it worth running.

Python and Skript are where I’m most confident. I’m continuing to learn Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS through plugins, websites and practical tools.

Self-hosting pulled me into Linux, Docker and networking. Running my own infrastructure means there is always another problem to understand properly instead of papering over.
